personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: A tool that deletes folders on my laptop scares me, but it never touches anything uncommitted or unpushed, so the worst it does is make me re-add a worktree.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: When a slice ends red, its worktree is where I go to see what broke, with its logs and node_modules already installed. Remove it at the end of the yolo and I reclone and reinstall just to understand the failure.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: I run yolo after yolo on every repository; a full disk is the one thing that stops me, and now it never fills up.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: One command with a dry run that every developer and runner shares is cleaner than each of us writing our own cleanup script.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: I do not master the harness, so I am glad the kit cleans after itself instead of asking me which folders I may delete.
